gap: Determine whether nonlinear-only temporal compression retains offline forecast and command-response capacity under matched fresh fitting.

fit.recipe: Unchanged production _train / fit_sequence: 1000 full-cache safeguarded Adam attempts; checkpoint every100; lowest-development checkpoint selected; seed0; same1536training/256development windows. Fresh fits for BOTH current full model and compact candidate, three models per arm. No tuning or early success stop.
fit.data: Exact cached train/development arrays and recording roles from the three authenticated adopted public models. This controls source roles; cached horizons are250ms, unlike some earlier long-horizon experimental training. Candidate and fresh v8 use identical roles/budgets; deployed incumbent remains a separate comparator.
fit.instrumentation: A wrapper around the unchanged trial_parameters function prints attempted-step progress every100; returns its output without arithmetic changes. No evaluation outcomes enter fitting or checkpoint selection.
fit.execution: Up to three local CPU fit processes concurrently; identical runtime/precision. Fit wall times are descriptive, not a speed comparison. Preserve every failure, full traces and selected weights. The prior exclusive online pair remains timing authority.

evaluation.flight_roster: All8064 saved factual/counterfactual queries across Crazyflow/Cascade known14m/15m cohorts; same history and command availability, targets and horizons. No native simulator calls or additional training.
evaluation.forecast: Score factual query predictions against recorded states. Velocity/rate vector RMSE and rotation geodesic angle at each declared horizon; top-decile velocity/rate tails.
evaluation.response: Score predicted counterfactual-minus-factual velocity/rate changes against the same differences in truth. Rotation response is factual-relative rotation; compare predicted and true relative rotations geodesically. Physical response is distinct from numerical derivative fidelity.
evaluation.weighting: Pool queries within each cohort/scope/kind/horizon, report absolute metrics and count. Equal geometric weights across scopes, cohorts and declared horizons within each family/kind. Equal family weights, equal velocity/rate primary weights. Denominator floor1e-9. Full per-group results retained.
evaluation.dart_heldout: Original test10/test11 ordinary recordings only, origins50,75,100,125,150,175, full120-step issued-command forecasts. Score10ms,250ms,600ms,1200ms. These are known held-out records, not new blind data.
evaluation.derivatives: At first four fully available eligible queries per flight cohort and Dart query rows0,1,6,7: seeded Gaussian unit-norm command direction, float64 JVP, centered finite differences at1e-4 and1e-5. Check every fine-difference element with atol1e-6+rtol2e-4*abs(JVP), preserve coarse values. No physical derivative claim from this check.
evaluation.batching: Batches of32 at full saved horizon. Pad absent command suffix with last available command and score only real prefixes; causal invariance covered by model tests. Preserve ineligible arrays as NaN. This may change floating-point grouping vs saved incumbent arrays; incumbent is reevaluated under the same batching.

decision: Keep original numeric diagnostic limits: forecast/response primary at most1.05, each-family combined at most1.10, aggregate rate/orientation at most1.05, tails at most1.10, finite derivatives. These are evidence, not individual vetoes. Weigh compactness, learning accuracy, measured whole-update cost and lost flexibility together. The online screen preserved aggregate accuracy with37.46%fewer quad parameters but was6.1%slower on CPU; offline qualification addresses the still-unresolved capability question, not a speed claim. Do not claim gains on other hardware. No new Dart controller trial solely for a small benchmark miss; evaluate known held-out Dart forecasts under the declared four horizons. Maintain current full model unless overall evidence warrants migration.
